test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Easiness
solution: The correct answer is: **Gullibility**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Easiness **means something that is easy or not difficult. (कुछ ऐसा जो आसान हो या कठिन न हो) • Marked option **Gullibility **means easily fooled or deceived. (आसानी से मूर्ख बनाया या धोखा दिया जा सकता है) • The two words are similar in that they both imply a lack of difficulty or resistance. • **For example**: *The easiness of the puzzle made it perfect for children, but adults found it too simple and boring.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Immunity **means protection or resistance against a disease or harmful substance. (किसी बीमारी या हानिकारक पदार्थ से सुरक्षा या प्रतिरोध) • **Fraternity **means a group of people sharing a common interest or profession. (समान रुचि या पेशा साझा करने वाले लोगों का समूह) • **Indomitability **means being unable to be defeated or overcome. (पराजित होने में असमर्थ होना) 1cf:T8cd, The correct answer is: **Condision**
